definitions.gloss: to scrape together, to rake up
definitions.explanation: To physically gather scattered things by scraping or raking them into one place.

definitions.gloss: to scrape together, to round up
definitions.explanation: To gather with effort from various sources, often implying difficulty or urgency.

examples.japanese: {砂|すな}を{掻|か}き{集|あつ}めた。
{落|お}ち{葉|ば}を{掻|か}き{集|あつ}めて{袋|ふくろ}に{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I raked up the fallen leaves and put them in a bag.

examples.japanese: {散|ち}らばった{書類|しょるい}を{掻|か}き{集|あつ}めて{机|つくえ}の{上|うえ}に{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: I gathered up the scattered documents and put them back on the desk.

examples.japanese: {資金|しきん}をなんとか{掻|か}き{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: I somehow scraped together the funds.

examples.japanese: ボランティアを{掻|か}き{集|あつ}めてイベントを{開催|かいさい}した。
examples.english: We rounded up volunteers and held the event.

examples.japanese: {締|し}め{切|き}り{前|まえ}に{各部署|かくぶしょ}から{情報|じょうほう}を{掻|か}き{集|あつ}めて{報告書|ほうこくしょ}をまとめた。
examples.english: I gathered information from each department before the deadline and compiled the report.

notes:
USAGE: {掻|か}き{集|あつ}める is a compound verb combining {掻|か}く (to scrape, to scratch) and {集|あつ}める (to gather). The {掻|か}き～ prefix adds a nuance of hasty or vigorous action.

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}). Takes を for what is being gathered.

ASPECT: {掻|か}き{集|あつ}めている indicates ongoing gathering activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{資金|しきん}を{掻|か}き{集|あつ}める (to scrape together funds)
・{情報|じょうほう}を{掻|か}き{集|あつ}める (to gather information)
・{人手|ひとで}を{掻|か}き{集|あつ}める (to round up workers)
・{落|お}ち{葉|ば}を{掻|か}き{集|あつ}める (to rake up fallen leaves)

NUANCE: Implies effort, urgency, or gathering from disparate sources. More emphatic than simple {集|あつ}める.
